scientific_integrity: The limiting constants and ratio are supported by a complete analytical factorization, Gaussian Laplace localization, and an upper/lower convolution argument. Finite numerical quadratures are supplementary only. No independent verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed a,b>0 and a C4 periodic modulation with unique nondegenerate global maximum and minimum; scalar whole-line uniform Ulam norm only. General Green-integral representations are prior work, and publication priority is not exhaustively certified.
title: Isospectral factor order produces a square-root separation of optimal periodic oscillator stability constants
